title: Dooring Chain Reaction Beside Tram Tracks
originalIntent: A parked driver opens a door into the cyclist's space. The lead cyclist swerves and brakes, ego brakes without entering the occupied tram lane, and the trailing cyclist stops. Maintain at least 2 seconds pre-event headway, at least 1 metre cyclist clearance, no contact, peak ego braking no greater than 7 m/s2, and at least 2 metres final gap.

criteria.description: Headway between ego and the lead cyclist from 0 through 5 seconds remains at least 2 seconds.
criteria.reason: The typed intent evaluator has no headway criterion; the unchanged scenario-specific gate evaluates this threshold on every trace.

criteria.description: Peak ego deceleration does not exceed 7 m/s2.
criteria.reason: The typed intent evaluator has no acceleration criterion; the unchanged scenario-specific gate evaluates this threshold on every trace.

criteria.description: The parked car's left door transitions through opening and open.
criteria.reason: The typed intent evaluator checks trigger firing but not arbitrary state-transition values; the unchanged scenario-specific gate evaluates both states on every trace.
